target.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes MS Teams group/channel file sends that could hang indefinitely when SharePoint upload, sharing-link creation, chat-member lookup, or drive-item metadata requests stalled before headers or while reading response bodies.

## Why This Change Was Made

The affected SharePoint/Graph calls now use an aborting timeout around the full fetch lifecycle, including response body reads. The timeout helper lives in `extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts`, the existing MS Teams timeout owner.

The SharePoint content PUT now has a transfer-specific 5 minute deadline. Short Graph control-plane requests keep the existing 30 second MS Teams request timeout so stalled metadata/link/member calls still fail quickly without breaking slow but valid file uploads.

## User Impact

MS Teams group/channel file sends no longer remain pending forever when Microsoft Graph or SharePoint stops responding. Slow valid uploads get a transfer-sized deadline instead of being cut off at 30 seconds.

## Evidence

Exact head: `f1f83bfee4e451fe92226d76dc96082aff18707c`.

Implementation updates after ClawSweeper/CI review:

- Fixed CI lint failure `typescript(prefer-promise-reject-errors)` in `extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts`.
- Moved the aborting timeout wrapper into `extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts`.
- Split deadlines: SharePoint content upload uses `MSTEAMS_SHAREPOINT_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 300000`; Graph control-plane calls keep `MSTEAMS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000`.
- Added focused regression coverage for stalled upload abort, response-body stall abort, slow upload success after 30s, and control-plane stall abort.
- Updated the branch with normal merges from `upstream/main` / `gh pr update-branch`; no rebase or force-push.
- The follow-up from `355cc9e1f6c6567349853ee077b3ded75dff6ce3` to `b9ab8dddcf6ad2ea64e5eeb04a12e3a7e0527250` is test-only (`extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts`) and only normalizes test rejection reasons for CI lint. The later `f1f83bfee4e451fe92226d76dc96082aff18707c` head is the normal update-branch merge.

Validation run locally because Crabbox/Testbox is unavailable in this environment:

```text
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD -- extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts
-> clean

node_modules/.bin/oxlint extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts
-> clean

node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.ts extensions/msteams/src/request-timeout.ts extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts
-> All matched files use the correct format.

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/graph-upload.test.ts
-> 1 file passed, 11 tests passed
```

Controlled partial SharePoint/Graph stalled-transport proof:

```text
node --import tsx --input-type=module
```

Harness shape: production `uploadAndShareSharePoint()` / `uploadToSharePoint()` helpers, real Node HTTP loopback server, real `fetch()` transport to loopback, redacted token provider, and a transport shim that redirects Microsoft Graph/SharePoint URLs to loopback paths. This is intentionally not described as a live Microsoft tenant run. The runtime transcript was captured at `355cc9e1f6c6567349853ee077b3ded75dff6ce3`; current head only adds a test-helper lint fix and normal update-branch merge.

Redacted transcript:


Observed behavior:

- Slow SharePoint upload that finishes after 31s succeeds; the 30s control-plane timeout no longer aborts content upload.
- Stalled SharePoint `createLink` control-plane request still rejects after about 30s and the server observes socket close.
- Stalled SharePoint content upload rejects after about 300s and the server observes socket close.

Known limits:

- This proof runs production MS Teams graph-upload helpers through real HTTP loopback stalls/success, but it is still not a live Microsoft Graph/SharePoint tenant proof.
- No Microsoft tenant credentials were available in this environment, so a real group/channel file send against Microsoft services remains untested.
- Remote Crabbox/Testbox proof was unavailable because the selected `crabbox` binary failed basic `--version`/`--help` sanity checks; this used the documented narrow local fallback plus GitHub CI.
